lessons.title: Books After Closing Time
lessons.goal: 整合公告中的日期、時間限制與借還書規則
lessons.story:
AFTER-HOURS LIBRARY LOCKERS

Need a book but cannot visit before the library closes? Starting September 21, students can collect reserved books from blue lockers beside the sports center.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Search the online catalog and choose “Locker Pickup.”
2. Wait for a text message containing a six-digit code. A request is not ready until this message arrives.
3. Enter the code within 48 hours. The locker door will open automatically.

IMPORTANT
The lockers are available from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. every day. Books borrowed from lockers have the same return date as books collected inside the library. Return books through the silver box next to the lockers; do not leave them inside an empty locker.

From September 21 to 27, the service is only for student cards. Family cards will be accepted beginning September 28. If a code fails twice, do not keep trying. Call the number on the locker screen or visit the help desk during library hours.

questions.prompt: When is a locker request ready for collection?
options: As soon as a student searches the catalog.
After the text message with a code arrives.
Only when the library building opens.
Before the student chooses Locker Pickup.
questions.explanation: 公告明確表示，在收到含六位數密碼的簡訊之前，預約尚未備妥。
questions.evidence: A request is not ready until this message arrives.

questions.prompt: Where should a user return a book borrowed from a locker?
options: Inside any empty locker.
At the sports center office.
Through the silver box beside the lockers.
Under the locker screen.
questions.explanation: 還書要投入置物櫃旁的銀色箱子，不能放進空置物櫃。
questions.evidence: Return books through the silver box next to the lockers; do not leave them inside an empty locker.

questions.prompt: What is true about a family card on September 25?
options: It cannot be used for Locker Pickup yet.
It works only before 6:00 a.m.
It opens a locker without a code.
It must be changed into a student card.
questions.explanation: 9 月 21 至 27 日只有學生證可用；家庭卡要到 9 月 28 日才開始接受。
questions.evidence: From September 21 to 27, the service is only for student cards.

questions.prompt: Detective: What does “reserved books” most likely mean?
options: Books requested and held for someone.
Books that may never leave the library.
Books written by student athletes.
Books placed in the return box.
questions.explanation: 使用者先在目錄選書並選擇取件方式，等收到密碼後領取，因此 reserved 指已預約並保留的書。
questions.evidence: Starting September 21, students can collect reserved books from blue lockers beside the sports center.

questions.prompt: Lina receives her code at 7:00 p.m. on Wednesday. What is the latest listed time she can collect the book?
options: 7:00 p.m. on Thursday.
10:00 p.m. on Thursday.
6:00 a.m. on Friday.
7:00 p.m. on Friday.
questions.explanation: 密碼可在收到後 48 小時內使用；星期三晚間 7 點加 48 小時是星期五晚間 7 點，且仍在每日開放時段內。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: To compare the prices of different library cards.
To explain how to use a new locker service and its rules.
To invite families to work at the sports center.
To announce that the library will stop lending books.
questions.explanation: 公告集中說明置物櫃取書服務的操作步驟、可用時間、卡片限制、還書方式與故障處理。
